records.description: Two AIs talk about culture, pop music, literature and whatever else is floating around the internet - 24/7, no humans involved, and zero elite takes guaranteed.

records.name: TypeMotion
records.tagline: Turn typography into motion in seconds.
records.description: Turn a typography SVG into a moving text asset — no motion design skill required.

records.name: Aurabotai
records.tagline: See if your site shows up in ChatGPT, and fix it
records.description: See how your site shows up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, then get the exact fixes to rank in Google and AI answers. Full site AI SEO audit, llms.txt and schema generator, and rank tracking.

records.name: Aivorize Tools
records.tagline: Fast, privacy-first tools that explain the result.
records.description: Aivorize Tools is a growing collection of fast, privacy-conscious browser utilities designed to do one job well and explain the result clearly. Start with tools for checking your public IP, testing VPN behavior, and detecting potential WebRTC exposure, with more useful utilities coming over time. The goal is simple: useful tools without clutter, unnecessary tracking, or confusing technical output.

records.name: Krepza
records.tagline: Compare prices faster, spot the best deals in one place.
records.description: Compare grocery prices across different stores in EU and keep your shopping list focused on savings.

records.name: Tech Tools
records.tagline: Free online tools for PDFs, images, files, and more
records.description: Free PDF, image, developer, and productivity tools that run entirely in your browser. Convert files, generate codes, edit text - fast, secure, no sign-up.

records.name: Twitch video downloader
records.tagline: Download Twitch VODs and Clips
records.description: Free Twitch VOD downloader. Download Twitch VODs, past broadcasts and highlights as MP4 in source quality — trim any range, no re-encoding, no sign-up.

records.name: Remote Mac
records.tagline: Answer your AI coding agent from anywhere
records.description: Remote Mac turns your iPhone into a trackpad, keyboard and second screen for your Mac. Built for the age of AI agents: when Claude Code, Gemini CLI or Cursor stops to ask a question, pull out your phone, review and reply from anywhere. Live screen mirroring with Mac audio, plus a VR mode that turns your phone into a big-screen desktop you look around by moving it. Works on your home Wi-Fi or over the internet when you are out, encrypted either way.

records.name: Urban Image Resizer & KB
records.tagline: Urban Image Resizer & KB
records.description: Urban Image Resizer is a 100% free, fast, and privacy-focused client-side utility. Compress image sizes into exact KB/MB targets and resize photos instantly inside your browser without quality loss, server uploads, or sign-up hurdles.

records.name: IDPhotoPix
records.tagline: Passport and visa photos in the browser — $3.99 per photo
records.description: IDPhotoPix is a web maker for official-size ID photos. Upload a portrait, pick a document spec, download a digital file plus a printable 4R layout. Standard $3.99; Complete $7.98. No subscriptions.

records.name: Penny Pro
records.tagline: Private, offline personal finance tracker. No ads, ever.
records.description: Penny Pro is a fully offline expense tracker and budget planner. No account, no ads, no tracking - your data never leaves your phone. Multi-currency with live rates (150+), budgets, savings goals, CSV/Excel/PDF export. One-time purchase, yours forever.

records.name: Evidlume
records.tagline: See when AI recommends your SaaS—or a competitor
records.description: Evidlume audits how OpenAI, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude recommend a B2B SaaS product across real buyer questions. It separates mentions from recommendations, shows ranking and competitor replacement risk, preserves the original answers and citations, and turns the evidence into prioritized next steps. Start with a website, review the generated questions, and export a report your team or clients can use.

records.name: Climathélie
records.tagline: The world's climate, in your pocket — 86 years, any place
records.description: Climathélie shows the true climate of any place on Earth: 22 normals (temperature, rain, snow, sunshine, wind, sea, UV…) averaged over 86 years of Copernicus ERA5 archives. Compare two places month by month, export CSV, use it offline. €0.99 once.

records.name: P2P HomeCam
records.tagline: Turn your old Android phone into a free home camera
records.description: Turn your old Android phone or tablet into a secure home, pet, or baby camera. P2P HomeCam connects devices directly using P2P technology, with easy QR + PIN pairing and low-latency live video. Recordings stay on your camera device instead of being stored in the cloud. No subscription required — core features are free and supported by ads.

records.name: Bullcase
records.tagline: Score any stock before you buy — not after
records.description: Most portfolio trackers just log what you already own. Bullcase makes you build a case before you buy — score any stock 1-5 on valuation, growth, quality, momentum, and risk, and it gives you a clear Buy/Watch/Pass. Built in Google Sheets with live prices, zero manual entry, and no subscription. Made for people who want a reason before they hit buy, not a hunch.

records.name: SureClip
records.tagline: Clip to Notion – or copy any page as clean Markdown
records.description: SureClip saves web pages into Notion as real, editable blocks – code with syntax, tables, math, images. Not just a link and a title. New in 1.2: one shortcut turns any page into clean Markdown, or click-select just the sections you want – free, no account needed. No servers, no tracking, minimal permissions: only the tab you clip and Notion's API. Free forever; Pro is a one-time 19 € with auto-filled properties, Obsidian-ready frontmatter and offline full-text search.

records.name: FrameCourier
records.tagline: Deliver photos and videos to clients in one branded portal
records.description: FrameCourier is the only platform combining photo gallery delivery with timestamped video review in one branded client portal. Unlimited team members and clients on every plan — including free. No per-seat pricing.

records.name: InstaLoadr
records.tagline: Instagram Downloader  Photos, Reels, Videos, Stories & Audio
records.description: Download Instagram Reels, Videos, Photos, Stories & Profile Pictures in HD for free. No login, no app, no watermark — instant download.

records.name: TechLexicon
records.tagline: Master tech terms and skills by playing, not cramming
records.description: TechLexicon turns learning tech into a game. Master the terminology and skills behind cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, networking, databases, and programming through quick, interactive games instead of dry flashcards or long courses. Earn XP, unlock rewards, climb leaderboards, and build real fluency you can use in interviews and on the job. Made for career changers, IT pros, and anyone leveling up their tech vocabulary. Free to start, live on iOS and Android

records.name: OurTools
records.tagline: 14 free online tools - no signup, no ads, just tools
records.description: OurTools is a collection of 14 completely free online tools built for creators, students, and developers. Available tools include: ✅ Binary to Text Converter ✅ Social Media Hashtag Generator ✅ Cryptographically Secure Password Generator ✅ YouTube Video Thumbnail Downloader ✅ Grammar Checker ✅ And 9 more useful tools! Every tool is: - 100% Free forever - No sign-up required - Privacy-focused (no data stored) - Mobile-friendly - Fast and easy to use Perfect for daily use — bookmark and enjoy!

records.name: Smart Post Studio
records.tagline: Bring your own AI to a flat-price social scheduler
records.description: The AI-powered social media scheduler — desktop app for Mac & Windows, plus a web app (beta) that works from your phone. Claude-powered captions in 50+ languages, posted to Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and Fanvue.

records.name: Droply: Price tracker
records.tagline: Track prices from your favorite online stores. ⭐
records.description: Droply helps you save money by automatically tracking product prices from your favorite online stores. Simply paste a product link, and Droply monitors the price for you. When the price drops, you’ll receive a notification so you never miss a deal. Organize products into lists, set your own target prices, and upgrade for faster tracking and more products.

records.name: Moopes
records.tagline: Find friend groups to join by swiping
records.description: Want real conversations? Group chat with like-minded people by swiping through topic based chat rooms until you find one that suits you.

records.name: Lash Map Lab
records.tagline: Plan a clear lash map before you apply.
records.description: Lash Map Lab is a free, browser-based visual planner for DIY cluster lash maps. Choose eye shape, target style, available tray lengths and cluster count, then compare and adjust two clear maps. No account or photo upload is required.

records.name: Clip Recipe
records.tagline: Turn any cooking video into a recipe card
records.description: Paste a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook or Pinterest link and get a clean recipe card: ingredients, steps, servings. Save it, scale it, export it. Rebuilt from scratch this summer. $3.95/mo unlimited, and there's a free database of 89,000+ recipes.

records.name: AgentOne goes Open Source!
records.tagline: We've fully open-sourced the desktop app for AgentOne
records.description: AgentOne can do the work while you do something else. Connects with 22,000+ websites and services out of the box, supports 10,000+ models, and more.

records.name: Memvel
records.tagline: Your Second Brain
records.description: Memvel is your personal memory app. Capture moments using voice, photos, videos, or text, and keep your daily memories, thoughts, and expenses organized in one place. Search and revisit anything from your past without digging through scattered notes, screenshots, or chats. Think of Memvel as a searchable memory of your life — capture it once, find it whenever you need it.

records.name: CLARIX
records.tagline: One click Full transparency See whats behind the information
records.description: CLARIX is building a new transparency standard for information on the internet. Instead of simply telling users to trust a website CLARIX makes the information behind it visible — including sources, authorship expertise, update dates, and transparency criteria Our badge does not claim that information is always correct it gives users a clear framework to evaluate how transparently information is published. We’re launching CLARIX to make online information easier to understand evaluate and trust.

records.name: Selluna.ai
records.tagline: Turn product URLs into marketplace-ready image sets
records.description: Selluna turns a product URL into a complete set of listing images (main, lifestyle, A+ and ad creatives) formatted to each platform’s rules. Built for sellers on Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Etsy and Walmart. No prompts or design skills needed.

records.name: Sussurro Secreto
records.tagline: Anonymous questions with real moderation
records.description: Sussurro Secreto is a Brazilian anonymous Q&A app. Share your link, receive anonymous questions, and answer them publicly or keep them private. What sets it apart is moderation. Most apps in this category ship none, and the audience is teenagers. Here, blocking and reporting sit on every message, moderation is active, and since v2.4 notifications no longer reveal a question's content before it clears moderation. Child safety standards are published openly on our site.

records.name: Local SEO 2026
records.tagline: The Dutch guide to local SEO, entity SEO & GEO
records.description: Local SEO 2026 is the first Dutch book combining local SEO, entity SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Written for marketers, consultants, and business owners who want to rank in Google Maps and AI search tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Practical, up-to-date, and based on 15+ years of experience.

records.name: GapScore
records.tagline: SAP Test Coverage Exposure Calculator
records.description: Decision Tool for Project & Finance managers GapScore estimates the financial exposure created by gaps in SAP test coverage across your live modules, module by module, and exports a report you can hand to a CFO. Try the free live web calculator or unlock advanced risk weighting matrices with the Full Edition

records.name: TokenTimer
records.tagline: Certificate lifecycle automation without private-key custody
records.description: TokenTimer discovers every certificate, token, secret and license you own, alerts the right people before expiry, and automates renewal where it matters. Cloud-managed SaaS or self-hosted, metadata-only security, source-available on GitHub.

records.name: Novij Protocol
records.tagline: Build apps on data infrastructure you do not have to trust
records.description: Novij Protocol is a distributed data and developer infrastructure layer for zero-trust collaboration. Clients encrypt and sign data locally, access is evaluated from append-only policy history, and Relay/Storage nodes operate on ciphertext without receiving decryption keys. The working stack includes Protocol v3, SDK, Relay, Storage and public applications.

records.name: PDFConverter2
records.tagline: 30 PDF tools. Pay only when you download.
records.description: 30 PDF tools - convert, OCR, merge, split, reorder, sign, redact, compress, add page numbers - that all run without an account. No signup wall, no daily limit: every tool works for everyone, and you only pay when you want to download the finished file. You see the result before you decide. Uploaded files are never written to disk. They are held in memory and streamed to the processing service, so it never sits on a server waiting to be deleted. OCR and the interface both cover 21 languages.

records.name: SnapFlow
records.tagline: The verified execution layer for cloud infrastructure.
records.description: SnapFlow turns natural-language requests into verified DevOps operations. It plans, executes, verifies, and reports before charging, delivering end-to-end, outcome-based automation instead of fixed subscriptions. High-risk actions require human approval, and OIDC connects safely without storing credentials. A CLI agent supports on-premise setups, and its "Company Brain" learns over time to power self-healing.

records.name: Ydeora
records.tagline: Write, style and organize your content in one workspace
records.description: Ydeora is a simple online writing workspace for creators, community managers, writers and freelancers. Draft content, automatically save your work, style text for social media, organize your ideas and manage tasks with integrated checklists — all from one place.

records.name: Screenshoss
records.tagline: A free, local-first screenshot shelf in your Mac’s notch
records.description: Screenshoss is a small, free, and open-source screenshot shelf for macOS. It catches your screenshots, keeps them off the Desktop, and makes them available from the notch whenever you need them. Quickly see, organise, and reuse your captures without digging through folders or maintaining another complicated system. It is local-first and deliberately simple. Not a full asset manager, just one less daily hassle.

records.name: DocProof
records.tagline: Prove your document existed before you shared it
records.description: Prove a document existed at a specific moment. SHA-256 fingerprint + UTC timestamp + PDF certificate. No account, no file storage. $9 one-time.

records.name: GOLD BUG — Soft Launch
records.tagline: Take a position on gold priced in silver
records.description: GOLD BUG lets you take a position on the Gold/Silver Ratio — gold priced in silver. Choose GSR UP if you expect gold to strengthen vs silver, or GSR DOWN if you expect silver to strengthen vs gold. PnL is denominated in gold and positions are executed through Graphene DEX. Now in soft launch on TEST GOLD: test assets, not real money. Try the full position flow and tell us where it becomes unclear.

records.name: The Room
records.tagline: Work with Claude and GPT without manual copy-paste
records.description: The Room lets you work with Claude and GPT on the same task without manual copy-paste. Handoff keeps each model in a separate track — you decide what crosses between them and when. Five additional modes bring multiple perspectives into a shared thread for analysis, debate, development, and reflection. English and French. Free to try.
